turn_text: Welcome to Advancing the Agenda. I'm Michael Abramson. My guest today is United States Congressman Andrew Clyde. Congressman Clyde represents the 9th Congressional District in Georgia, which is in the northeast part of the state. Congressman Andrew Clyde is a combat veteran, small business owner, and a proud Georgian. After earning his commission from the University of Notre Dame, he served as a U.S. Navy officer for 28 years, which included three combat deployments to Kuwait and Iraq. After receiving an honorable discharge, Congressman Clyde made his home in Athens, Georgia and earned a master's degree in corporate finance and entrepreneurship from the University of Georgia. He established Clyde Armory in 1991 and grew the company into a nationwide firearms business which currently operates two brick-and-mortar locations in Georgia. Congressman Clyde was first elected to serve George's ninth congressional district in the House of Representatives in November 2020. He currently serves on the House Appropriations Committee. Congressman Clyde, welcome to Advancing the Agenda.
